content:
One of the best AI-assisted transcription apps on the Mac just got even better with a major update that introduces a redesigned transcript editor and notable performance improvements. Here's what's new.

MacWhisper 14 has officially arrived

If you haven't heard of MacWhisper before, it's a fantastic app developed by prolific indie developer Jordi Bruin.

It lets users quickly and easily transcribe audio, video, meetings, and system sound into text directly on the Mac, using locally-running AI models including OpenAI's Whisper and Nvidia's lightning-fast Parakeet.

I use it daily in the pre- and post-production workflow for my podcast and can't recommend it highly enough.

Since launching MacWhisper in 2023, Bruin has continually expanded its features, streamlined its workflow, and delivered welcome performance improvements.

MacWhisper 14 continues in that direction with a redesigned editor, faster performance, and a number of other refinements.

Here's what Bruin had to share about the update:

According to Bruin, based on early user feedback, MacWhisper 14.1 has already been released with a number of fixes and improvements to the new editor. Version 14.1 also adds Gladia as a new cloud transcription provider, letting users transcribe with their own Gladia API key.

MacWhisper 14 also includes the following:

A redesigned, cleaner, easier-to-use AI services screen; updated AI models for several major providers; and smoother playback when working with multiple open transcripts at once.

MacWhisper Pro users get a free upgrade to version 14. Bruin is also offering a 14% discount for anyone looking to upgrade to Pro.

To learn more about what's new in MacWhisper 14, click here.
